title: TD SYNNEX Expands HPE Unleash AI Solutions to Accelerate Partner Delivery of Enterprise AI Solutions
summary: TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX), a leading global distributor and solutions aggregator for the IT ecosystem, today announced the expansion of its HPE Unleash AI solutions offerings, enabling partners to more easily identify, source and deploy certified AI applications as part of the NVIDIA AI Computing by HPE Portfolio. The expanded portfolio includes newly onboarded solutions from ISVs such as Aible, Smart Spatial, Kamiwaza, Iterate, Gambit, EPIC iO and Medical Informatics Corp, alongside established Unleash AI offerings already available through TD SYNNEX. Together, these solutions are part of Destination AI™ , TD SYNNEX’s comprehensive AI enablement framework, and support a broad range of AI use cases across industries, including computer vision, data intelligence, healthcare and smart environments.
